fenomeno.que: a giant backlit lightbox showing the Sika campaign artwork, glowing as the brightest object of the studio, its light falling softly on the floor and wall right next to it
fenomeno.esServicio: Creative Studio: la campaña que proponemos para Sika ya existe a escala real, como un afiche retroiluminado en nuestro estudio

escena: SCENE (staged cinematic editorial photograph, a large dark creative studio at night, the moment an art director presents a finished campaign): the back wall is a deep matte charcoal wall. On it hangs a GIANT frameless backlit fabric lightbox (a tension-fabric print lit from behind), perfectly flat and perfectly FRONTAL to the camera (no perspective, no tilt), a clean 16:9 rectangle with four sharp straight edges and four visible square corners: its left edge at about 44 % of the frame width and NEVER further left, its right edge at about 84 %, its top edge at about 10 % of the frame height and its bottom edge at about 53 %. The lightbox PRINTS the campaign artwork shown in image 6, filling it edge to edge in the same layout: the yellow left part with the big black word and the black headline, a diagonal cut, and on the right the photograph of the two cartridges standing in splashing water. It is a real backlit print: even light, the fabric texture faintly visible. Its glow falls softly on the charcoal wall just around it and on the floor below it, fading within half a meter. The art director, wearing the EFEONCE HOODIE in its royal blue, stands about one and a half meters in front of the wall to the RIGHT of the lightbox, NOT in front of it: the centre of her body at about 89 % of the frame width, her near shoulder at about 82 %, her curls never further left than 80 %, so BOTH cartridges in the print stay fully visible and uncovered. Camera about five meters from her at waist height, looking very slightly up, 85mm f/2.8; she is framed from the hips up, the top of her head at about 20 % of the frame height. She PRESENTS the print: her body turned three quarters toward the lightbox, her near arm extended toward it at waist height with the hand open, palm up, fingers relaxed, the gesture of someone showing their work; her hand stays BELOW the bottom edge of the lightbox and never covers the print; her other hand rests in the hoodie pocket. Her head is almost frontal and her eyes look straight into the lens with a confident, sly half smile. Her face is lit by the hard cold white key from the right, slightly in front; the lightbox beside her adds a soft warm yellow rim on the curls, the cheek and the shoulder that face it, and a faint yellow glow on her open palm. The LEFT 42 % of the frame is the charcoal wall in deep shadow: no light, no glow, no bokeh, no objects. Very little ceiling is visible. The whole frame outside the lightbox and that rim is cool and contemporary: cold white and deep blue-black, nothing amber, orange or golden, no tungsten, no retro glow. No other text anywhere, no other logos.

lecho.objeto: the dark blurred edge of a worktable close to the lens, low in the frame, outside every light

texto.muro: the charcoal wall in deep shadow on the left 42% of the frame

nota: Excepción del operador (2026-10-07): gráfica aprobada del cliente (Master Graphic Sika) dentro de una portada cine de Efeonce para la licitación Wherex 1164. Método de la sesión línea gráfica: escena generada CON el arte como referencia (imagen 6, pieza en uso) → arte exacto compuesto con homografía → acabado de materia y luz con ai:inpaint image Sunburst sólo en el lightbox. SK3 (operador 2026-10-07, «Hazlo»): Karo PRESENTA el afiche con la mano, cartuchos enteros, contraluz amarillo leve del lado del muro, cámara más baja y menos techo.
